title: A2's container-destroyed-mid-turn proof was never run on staging after a2l
description:
The only recorded staging result for A2's second fault is the pre-a2l shape: the workspace was emptied, the container was not destroyed. The README itself says the destroy is 'to be re-run at the next staging pass'. The code a2l added for a real destroy (the staging Worker's /proof/git origin, the dumb-HTTP origin, /proof/destroy) has never run on the platform. cni's restore-setup proof also only empties the workspace. Fix: run agent-faults-staging.ts with the whole-container destroy and record the result table. Staging deploys from the branch, so this need not wait for the merge.
